fidelity: F2a — Lumped Transient (N control volumes, two-stream + wall energy ODEs)
source: Kandlikar & Grande (2003) Heat Transfer Eng. 24(1); Incropera & DeWitt (2006) Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer 6th ed.; Shah & London (1978) Laminar Flow Forced Convection in Ducts; Webb & Kim (2005) Principles of Enhanced Heat Transfer.

unit.name: Aluminum hot-water / air crossflow microchannel core (Dh < 1 mm)

config.note: Lumped two-stream counterflow; steady state benchmarked vs e-NTU

N_cv.note: Number of control volumes per stream along flow direction (upwind discretisation; N>=40 keeps numerical diffusion < 1% vs e-NTU)

Dh.note: Hydraulic diameter 0.5 mm — microchannel regime (Kandlikar 10-200 um..3mm)

n_channels.note: Number of parallel microchannels per stream

m_wall.note: Total metal mass of separating wall / fins

Nu_laminar.note: Fully-developed laminar Nu, constant-q circular duct (Shah & London 1978; Incropera eq. 8.53)

cp_h.note: Liquid water cp at ~25C, 1 atm (Incropera Table A.6)

rho_h.note: Liquid water density at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

mu_h.note: Liquid water dynamic viscosity at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

k_fluid_h.note: Liquid water thermal conductivity at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

cp_c.note: Liquid water cp at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

rho_c.note: Liquid water density at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

mu_c.note: Liquid water dynamic viscosity at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

k_fluid_c.note: Liquid water thermal conductivity at ~25C (Incropera Table A.6)

air_cp.note: Dry air cp at ~300K (Incropera Table A.4) — used when stream='air'

air_rho.note: Dry air density at 300K, 1 atm (Incropera Table A.4)

air_mu.note: Dry air dynamic viscosity at 300K (Incropera Table A.4)

air_k.note: Dry air thermal conductivity at 300K (Incropera Table A.4)
